chapter: Carnegie Hall and the touring years
title: The Australian tour with Bill Haley
summary: A month in Australia with Haley, The Platters, The Drifters and a local rock 'n' roll band; photo with his mother at the airport.

story.theme_name: Going abroad: American jazz musicians touring and living in Europe
story.community_name: Going abroad: touring Europe and Japan

blocks.x: So then I took off and went to Australia. I left Wallace and the band up in Oakland, California. S'posed to go to Australia. I went to Australia, an' we stayed over there a month with Bill Haley and his band. 'Course I didn't sing with Bill Haley. I sang with the other band that was with us on the tour. We had The Platters, The Drifters, and a host of other players...all sorts of blues singers.
What was the band that backed you?
The band that backed me, I don't remember the name. It was just a band that people had picked up to go with us. I think his name was Charles. Charles 'n' His Rock 'n' Roll Boys.

So we went and played all up and down over in Australia. We made all the towns and all the cities. We stayed over there for about a month. So I bought me a bunch o' rings and stuff over there. I got a little badge [ ] from Australia. I got one of them right down in my house right now where I got it. I brought it to my mother.

So, before we left over, my mother and my sister and ever'body went to the airport with me, so we had a picture taken with Bill Haley and his band, my mother and my sister, LaVerne Baker, and a host o' other
people. So we got it...we had a picture taken so I got it in my house right now.
